name: Windows GitHub Runner VM
description: Creates a Windows Server 2025 QEMU/KVM VM from Microsoft's pre-built evaluation VHD and registers it as a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner (Windows service). Windows cannot run in an LXC container, so this is delivered as a VM. Importing the VHD skips Windows Setup entirely: the answer file and runner script are injected offline with virt-customize, and first boot runs OOBE unattended. The eval VHD is Generation 1, so the VM uses SeaBIOS with a driver-free IDE disk and E1000 NIC.

notes.text: Download the Windows Server 2025 evaluation VHD from the Microsoft Evaluation Center first, then give the script its path on the host (or an https URL reachable from the host).
You must provide a runner registration token (repo/org Settings -> Actions -> Runners -> New self-hosted runner). Registration tokens are short-lived, so run the script soon after generating one.

The evaluation image is a Generation 2 VHDX (UEFI/GPT), so the VM uses OVMF/UEFI on q35 with a SATA boot disk and an E1000 NIC (all driver-free). The VHDX is converted to qcow2 with qemu-img on import. Install VirtIO drivers + the QEMU guest agent afterwards and switch to virtio-scsi/virtio-net for better performance.
The Administrator password is randomly generated and printed once at the end of the script - save it immediately.
